confirmed_design: PREPARE_CODING freezes explicit original READ_WRITE workspace, session/writer/config CAS, exact relative paths and complete offline Go check dependency registry into original immutable idempotency confirmation; no model/config mutation. CONFIRM_CODING uses existing transaction-aware host.configure CAS and writes new immutable config/profile/plan/authorization in the same authority transaction; source must serialize against Scan to avoid transient model-only binding. STATUS_CODING reads original result only; no autoretry. Return only visible scope+source manifest/toolchain/vendor hash/count within64KiB; no token/full expanded policy to renderer. Runtime session/tool effects recheck original workspace/session authorization, not just modelRef.
qualification_semantics: Existing PREPARE→explicit CONFIRM gives new sameprofile oneMODEL/noTOOL qualification; normalcoding max8 and boundedtoolcalls, tool capability and semantic fix not accepted by text-only qualifier.
